title: Scarcity breaks in a world already pervaded
summary: The One pervades every color and form, while the measuring mind keeps circling through lack. Comparison weakens when fullness is seen before rank.
takeaway: Let the One filling every form end the scarcity chase.
lifeApplication: When the mind starts counting who has more, pause long enough to see the same Presence filling the scene before you answer it with envy.

source.shortMeaning: Every color and form is already pervaded by the One; scarcity belongs to the circling mind.
source.lifeApplication: When comparison narrows you, look again for the One already filling the people, places, and gifts in front of you.

evidence.coreClaim: The One pervades every color and form, so comparison is a failure of sight before it is a failure of confidence.
evidence.turn: Scarcity loses authority when the heart sees fullness before rank.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the mind starts counting who has more, pause long enough to see the same Presence filling the scene before you answer it with envy.
